claims.quote: A probe in `history/research/probes.json` can now say what the repository holds, not only what Lion does: `["repo/files", path]` lists the files under a folder, `["repo/read", path]` gives a file's text, `["repo/json", path]` gives a JSON file as a value, and `["repo/run", name]` runs a command declared in `history/research/commands.json` and gives `{"exit", "output"}`. So a decision record can assert how the project is set up and be checked: `["cond", [["string/includes", ["repo/read", ".husky/pre-commit"], "bun run test"], ["quote", "runs-tests"]], ["else", ["quote", "other"]]]` gives `"runs-tests"`, which is what the record of the quality gates asserts of the pre-commit hook.

A probe can answer for a feature as well as a behavior: `{"feature": "math/+", "kind": "function", "program": ["value/function?", "math/+"]}` gives `false`, so the record that says `math/+` is gone holds. `["lion/special-form?", name]` tells a probe whether Lion has a special form of that name. `bun run history check` reports a feature's probe that gives neither `true` nor `false`, and a question two probes answer.
